reviews.review: enormous fun. somebody put in the effort!

Shoot gun good,laser gun bad, music good, speed good, skill good. Overall very fun.

Full release addendum: The above but with a tiny big extra.

Edit after the "Super" update: The developers seems to have this weird fetish with invincibility bubbles so they decided to add them to every single arena. Guess none of them though that shooting isn't fun when your guns quite literally don't work on most enemies. Now you're have to just corner camp and hope the tiny robots walk in to view and not just hide in a corner. Also there's a reloadable boomerang....

Review on base game. Did not try multiplayer/co-op.
[b]TL/DR[/b] Its in early access but already have sunk many hours into it. If you like Doom you like this. Still some issues but for run and gun its great.
Recommendations for other run and gun games:
more story with lots of guns Borderland series.
similar game with heavy metal Doom series.

I only play on the hardest difficulty. You make runs through multiple levels going up in difficulty. You have different weapons you can find and equip, and unlock perks when you level up. Fight through enemies and bosses.

++ multiple unique bosses

(++ lots of different type of guns and powers

rougelite is not at its best currently.
